title: Maximus vs Happy Head vs PeterMD: Online Hair Loss Treatment Compared
description:
Maximus, Happy Head and PeterMD compared on who they're for, what they prescribe and how the online visit works.

What we compared:
• Maximus: focused on men's hair regrowth; oral finasteride, oral minoxidil and oral dutasteride options plus a compounded topical; a board-certified doctor reviews your questionnaire
• Happy Head: formulas for both men and women; personalized topical and oral formulas; topical minoxidil up to 8%; dermatologist-founded, free online consultation
• PeterMD: men-focused; Follicure RX topical spray with minoxidil, finasteride and ketoconazole

Provider details as listed in our reviews (updated Aug 2026). Confirm current options on each provider's site.

Full guide: https://www.treatmentshub.com/hair-loss
The comparison page this video is based on was reviewed for medical accuracy by Francheska Capistrano, RMT, MPH (medical content reviewer) on Oct 30, 2026.

Important:
• The presenter in this video is AI-generated.
• TreatmentsHub is a comparison site, not a medical provider. This is general information, not medical advice.
• Prescription treatment needs an evaluation by a licensed clinician, who decides whether it's right for you.
• Oral minoxidil is prescribed off-label for hair loss. Finasteride and dutasteride are generally not recommended for women, especially during pregnancy.
• We may earn a commission from partner links. It never affects our rankings.
How we rank: https://www.treatmentshub.com/weight-loss/how-we-rank
